subject: CPPO activation for Acme Commerce — go-live ramp and escalation paths
messages:
From: CloudResell OPS <ops@cloudresell.example>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: CPPO request: Acme Commerce (RDW-ACME-2319) — entitlement & go-live window

Hi Olga / Ben —

Quick note from CloudResell on behalf of Acme Commerce (Lina copied for visibility). They'd like to move forward with a Channel Partner Private Offer (CPPO) and target a restricted go-live for their pilot on 2026-11-24. Key asks from their procurement:

- Confirm SKU entitlement mapping (they have 3 SKU tiers: dev/prod/enterprise)
- Lock pricing and PO path (they'll issue a monthly commitment)
- Evidence needed for billing entity mapping and invoice flow for reseller split

I've attached the initial entitlement matrix that Acme filled out and their draft PO terms. Can your team confirm the entitlement flow and any known blocking tech/invoice steps by COB Thu 11/12?

Attachments: entitlement_matrix_acme_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), acme_private_offer_terms_v3.docx (doc)

Thanks,
Jared | CloudResell Partnerships Ops
Attachment: entitlement_matrix_acme_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

--

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CPPO request: Acme Commerce (RDW-ACME-2319) — entitlement & go-live window

Ben / Priyom —

Thanks Jared — forwarding the ask. Ben, can you confirm whether the entitlement matrix maps cleanly to our marketplace SKU hierarchy? Priyom, can you confirm whether the reseller invoice split and entity mapping require any manual entitlements on our side or if the CPPO flow (reseller account + purchaser) covers it end-to-end?

We should also confirm an escalation path in case the DocuSign/PO timing slips into next week — propose: Vanessa (billing) -> Ben (marketplace ops) -> me (partner success) -> Jared (CloudResell).

Please reply with the list of blockers and a suggested runbook by EOD today. If we can't close by 11/12 we'll need to push the pilot to 11/30 to avoid weekend cutover.

Olga
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jared <ops@cloudresell.example>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CPPO request: Acme Commerce (RDW-ACME-2319) — entitlement & go-live window

Olga / team —

Quick read of the attached entitlement matrix: mostly clean but two items to flag:

1) Enterprise SKU (ACME-ENT) maps to a multi-tenant prod SKU that requires a billing entity override in the marketplace. We can support this, but it requires a short PR to the entitlement service (1 business day) and explicit reseller mapping on the CPPO.

2) The dev SKU has a per-seat variant that isn't enabled for marketplace metering today; enabling it will require a config flip and a small patch (estimate < 4 hours).

Runbook suggestion:
- Today (11/12): Priyom to confirm billing entity paths and whether we need manual invoice split entries.
- 11/13 AM: Ben to submit entitlement PR and toggle dev SKU flag (target completion 11/13 EOD).
- 11/15: Vanessa to verify CPPO invoice split in sandbox and confirm DocuSign links are correct.
- 11/18: Final verification with CloudResell and Acme; formal DocuSign sign-off.

Blocking items: need Acme procurement to confirm the billing entity IDs (they sent a placeholder name in the matrix). If we don't have that by 11/13 we'll miss the 11/24 pilot.

Ben
Sr Partner Ops Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: none

--

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jared <ops@cloudresell.example>, Lina Cortez <lina.cortez@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CPPO request: Acme Commerce (RDW-ACME-2319) — entitlement & go-live window

Olga / Ben —

I've reviewed the billing path. For a reseller split with CloudResell the expected flow is supported by CPPO, but two confirmations are required from Acme: the purchaser payor entity (legal payor) and the reseller invoice destination (CloudResell's payee ID).

Action items I completed now:
- Confirmed that the entitlement PR is limited to SKU mapping and does not require infra downtime.
- Noted invoice split needs to be set in marketplace metadata; Vanessa will need to apply the invoice routing flag in sandbox for 11/15 verification.

I've also attached a short checklist for procurement fields Acme must fill out to avoid delays — Lina, can you fill in the payor/reseller IDs by EOD 11/13? If not, we trigger the fallback plan: delay pilot to 11/30 and put the CPPO in "pending-docs" state so no live billing occurs.

PRIYOM
Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference
Attachment: procurement_fields_checklist.txt (text)

--

From: Lina Cortez <lina.cortez@acme.com>

Subject: Re: CPPO request: Acme Commerce (RDW-ACME-2319) — entitlement & go-live window

Thanks everyone — quick update from Acme procurement:

- Attached completed payor/reseller IDs and the signed terms PDF (we uploaded to DocuSign).
- We've signed the CPPO term sheet; DocuSign reference: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/DocuSign-Acme-RDW-PO-2319
- We can confirm the enterprise SKU mapping and will accept the manual entitlement PR.

Request: can you confirm the exact maintenance window (if any) for the entitlement PR and the earliest time we can start the pilot after DocuSign completes? We want to avoid any overlap with our internal billing month cut on 11/24.

If there are any last-minute blockers please escalate to Vanessa (billing) as prioritized in the runbook.

Best,
Lina Cortez
Head of Cloud Procurement | Acme Commerce
